# AI Builds Navies — Naval Provisioning Law
#
# New law category controlling naval supply production methods.
# Standard provisioning uses vanilla tin-based recipe (most efficient).
# Alternatives unlock copper, iron, or timber methods with trade-offs.
#
# Generated by tools/calculate_maintenance.py

wpdo_naval_provisioning = {
	law_category = military

	potential = {
		OR = {
			num_of_ports > 0
			has_law = wpdo_naval_provisioning
		}
	}

	bronze_provisioning = {
		country_modifier = { wpdo_standard_naval_provisioning = yes }
		estate_preferences = { burghers_estate }
		years = 2
	}

	copper_sheathing = {
		country_modifier = {
			naval_damage_taken = 0.1
			navy_repair_cost = -0.15
			wpdo_can_produce_copper_naval_supplies = yes
		}

		estate_preferences = { burghers_estate }
		years = 2
	}

	iron_reinforcement = {
		country_modifier = {
			naval_damage_taken = -0.1
			navy_repair_cost = 0.15
			wpdo_can_produce_iron_naval_supplies = yes
		}

		estate_preferences = { burghers_estate peasants_estate }
		years = 2
	}
}
